findings.text: In Rom 2:15 conflicting thoughts are reasonings within a person that argue with one another: the person does it, in himself, as an inner debate.

parts.grounds: their conflicting thoughts accuse or even excuse them

findings.text: In Rom 2:15 the reasonings accuse the person or else excuse him: the working takes the part of a judge over the self, in either direction.
In Rom 2:15 the reasonings work beside the conscience, which bears witness, and the heart, on which the work of the law is written: heart, conscience and reasonings are named together.

parts.grounds: while their conscience also bears witness
